t: The Inventory Manager can communicate with the player's inventory. You need to right click a Memory Card and put the card into the manager to use it.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/inventory_manager/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
库存管理器可与玩家的物品栏进行通信。你需要手持记忆卡对其右键点击，并将该记忆卡放入库存管理器中，方可启用此功能。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/inventory_manager/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your Inventory Manager to a computer to make use of it!
将你的库存管理器连接至计算机即可使用！
